title: Lightning Rider
synopsis: A late delivery rider in Lagos is struck by lightning and becomes the fastest person in the city, just as a stranger starts drinking the power grid. An original cartoon superhero story with a different look for every character.

surge.name: Surge
surge.role: The man who drinks the grid

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Lagos never sleeps, and neither does Tobi. He delivers food on a battered motorbike, and he is always, always a little bit late.

scenes.speaker: chidi
scenes.text: Tobi! You are late again. The jollof is cold, the customer is angry, and your grandmother called me twice. Twice!

scenes.speaker: tobi
scenes.text: Traffic, Chidi. The whole city is in traffic. If I could only go faster than all of it, I would be a rich man by Friday.

scenes.speaker: ife
scenes.text: My boy, a rich man is not the one who arrives first. He is the one who arrives, and is welcome. Now eat something before the lights go out.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Mama Ife was right about the lights. All week, the city had been dimming, street by street, as if something out there was drinking the power.

scenes.speaker: kemi
scenes.text: I am Dr. Kemi, from the grid control. Every night, a quarter of the current goes missing. Not lost. Taken. And tonight the thief comes to the old pylon on Adeola Street.

scenes.speaker: tobi
scenes.text: Then I will deliver my last order there. I was going that way anyway. Chidi, keep the bus warm.

episodes.title: The Night the Sky Struck Back

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The old pylon hummed in the dark, thick with cables and the smell of rain. Tobi leaned his bike against it, and looked up.

scenes.speaker: tobi
scenes.text: Hello? Delivery for the thief. Cash on arrival. Extra pepper.

scenes.speaker: spark
scenes.text: Beep. Warning. Storm cell overhead. Please step away from the transformer. Please. Please step away.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The sky split open. A single bolt of lightning fell straight onto the pylon, and the pylon threw it straight into Tobi.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: When he opened his eyes, the rain had stopped, in mid air. Every drop hung glittering around him like tiny lamps, and Tobi was standing quite still in the middle of it.

scenes.speaker: tobi
scenes.text: Why is everything so slow? Spark! Why are you making that face? Spark, say something!

scenes.speaker: spark
scenes.text: Beep. You are moving at four hundred kilometres per hour, Tobi. And you appear to be glowing. Please do not touch anything.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: He ran the length of Adeola Street before his first heartbeat finished. And when he stopped, grinning, with his hair standing on end, he knew that he was never going to be late again.

episodes.title: The Man Who Drank the Grid

scenes.speaker: kemi
scenes.text: Tobi, this is serious. The thief is called Surge. He was an engineer once. His machine now feeds on electricity, and it feeds on the city.

scenes.speaker: tobi
scenes.text: So I run faster than he drains. Easy. Chidi, I will need a mask and a cape. Something with a bolt on it, something proud.

scenes.speaker: ife
scenes.text: I made it from your grandfather's red coat, and a little yellow cloth. Do not tear it, my boy. And do not forget to eat.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: That night, every light in Lagos flickered at once. A tall man in a purple coat walked into the central station, with a machine humming on his back like a swarm of bees.

scenes.speaker: surge
scenes.text: Ah. The city is so bright, and so wasteful. All these lamps burning for nobody. I will drink them, and I will be brighter than all of you.

scenes.speaker: kemi
scenes.text: Surge, stop. You will burn out the whole grid. Hospitals, schools, everything. There are people who need those lights.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: And then a red streak crossed the hall, so fast that the air cracked behind it. A rider in a cape stood in front of the machine, panting, and not at all late.

scenes.speaker: surge
scenes.text: A boy in a cape. Charming. You are all current, child, and I eat current. Let us see how long you can run before I catch you.

scenes.speaker: tobi
scenes.text: I have been running my whole life, Surge, and I have never once been caught. Not even by the police. Chidi, now!

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: Around the machine, down the corridor, across the roofs of Lagos. A red streak and a purple storm, racing, while the whole city held its breath.

scenes.speaker: chidi
scenes.text: Tobi, the bus! Jump on the bus! I am parked under the big pylon, the one he is trying to reach. Lead him here!

scenes.speaker: kemi
scenes.text: The machine is overloaded, Tobi. If you can pull enough current through it, faster than it can eat, it will break. Run in a circle. As fast as you can.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: So Tobi ran. Around the pylon, around the bus, around Surge himself, faster and faster until the lightning that had once changed him began to leave him again, in a ring of white fire.

scenes.speaker: surge
scenes.text: No. No, stop. It is too bright. I cannot hold it. I only wanted to be seen. I only wanted... the lights to look at me.

scenes.speaker: kemi
scenes.text: We see you, Surge. But not like this. Let me help you take the machine off, and I promise we will still be here in the morning.

scenes.speaker: narrator
scenes.text: The next evening, the lights of Lagos came on, all of them at once, brighter than anyone could remember. And somewhere above the traffic, a boy in a red cape was delivering dinner exactly on time.
